valuation_model: distribution-based sum-of-parts, finite concession lives, cost of equity

inputs.share_count_basis: fully diluted 1,453.3m = FY2025 diluted weighted average (AR2025 note 18, line 6878; 1,450.8m on issue + 2.5m performance rights); held FLAT — SBC (3.4m/yr) is expensed inside corporate costs, no buybacks, no non-SBC issuance

net_debt_composition.note: Project-level debt (TRIP II US$1.11bn face, Warnow EUR106m, CCPI/Skyway US$1.56bn, APRR/FE EUR7.1bn) is NON-RECOURSE and is NOT subtracted: the flows are already after project debt service (AFFO rule — capitalise post-interest flows at cost of equity, never deduct the debt again). Greenway (TRIP II in lock-up, B+/Negative, rate case pending) and Warnow contribute no cash in the horizon so their equity is carried as a scenario-specific lump in the bridge (matching-asset rule). Bear carries both at zero; bull 450/50. CSV total_debt 1,694.6 is TRIP II + Warnow only and is deliberately not used.

inputs.last_fcf_definition: FY2025 receipts (APRR/MAF2 498.2 + Skyway 18.7 + CCPI loan interest 18.1 = 535.0) less all centralised costs 52.6 (incl. one-offs and SBC) less corporate tax 8.0, EXCLUDING other finance income 20.2 (corporate cash is in the bridge). Company 'Operating free cash flow' was 505.9 (34.9cps) on the same year.
inputs.reported_fcf_basis: company-defined Operating free cash flow FY2025 (AR2025 p.23); statutory OCF-capex was 87.6 and is not a cash-generation measure for this holdco
inputs.sbc_source: AR2025 cash flow statement, share-based payments 3.4 (FY24 3.4, FY23 3.7); no equity-award tax withholding disclosed; expensed inside corporate costs (charged once, count flat)
inputs.interest_income_note: Other finance income 20.2 (corporate cash interest) stripped from the base — the cash is added in the bridge. CCPI shareholder-loan interest 18.1 is KEPT in the flows because it is Skyway asset income, not cash-pile income.
inputs.balance_sheet_note: FY2025 annual report (Dec-2025) is the latest filing in the folder; H1-2026 (27-Aug-2026) not downloaded. Known post-BS cash event applied: US$100m OTPP put settlement (1-Jul and 11-Aug-2026). Refresh corporate cash from the H1-2026 balance sheet when available.
inputs.fx_note: Statements and quote both AUD, but ~90% of receipts are EUR (APRR) and ~10% USD (Skyway). Converted at SPOT: EURAUD=X 1.6102 and AUDUSD=X 0.7131 (Yahoo, 2026-09-21). FY2025 averages were 1.7526 (1/0.5706) and 0.6444 — the AUD is ~8% stronger vs EUR and ~11% vs USD than the FY2025 base, which is why FY2026 receipts fall ~6% before any operating change (H1-26 proportional toll revenue -3.9% reported, +0.6% ex-FX). Scenario FX: bear 1.53/0.75, bull 1.70/0.68.
inputs.discount_rate_basis: COST OF EQUITY 8.5% in AUD: 10y ACGB ~4.3% + 0.8 beta x 5.25% ERP; flows are post project-level debt so WACC would double-count leverage. Same rate in all scenarios — risk is charged in the flows (receipt paths, FX, tail values), not in the rate.
inputs.lease_treatment: not applicable — corporate leases immaterial (A$0.8m principal); project-level obligations are inside non-recourse project debt, excluded from the bridge
notes: MODEL: distribution-based sum-of-parts with finite concession lives, discounted at cost of equity. Routed via dcf-methods: ALX is a holdco whose economics are an equity-accounted associate (APRR 30.82%, expiring Nov-2035; AREA Sep-2036) plus two levered US concessions; consolidated OCF (88.2) excludes the 516.8 of distributions booked in investing activities, and a perpetuity owner-FCF DCF would capitalise a stream that ends in 9 years. First valuation of this ticker (no memory entry).

HORIZON: 10 explicit years FY2026-FY2035 end exactly at APRR expiry. Terminal value = explicit PV at end-2035 of what survives: Skyway (66.67%, to 2104) as a 69-year growing annuity, AREA/ADELAC/A79 equity tails, plus (bull only) A$600m French re-concession optionality. The slider-engine fields express this as terminal_cap_multiple = residual / FY2035 FCF (base 4.6x); Gordon is never used.

APRR PATH: FY2025 receipts EUR286.9m carried TST (EUR43.7m ALX share). TST extended into 2026 then rolls off; ex-TST payout ~EUR330m grows with tolls to ~2031, then tapers FY2032-35 because APRR/FE net debt (EUR7.1bn, 3.1x EBITDA) cannot be refinanced past concession end and must be repaid from cash flow. Cumulative base receipts EUR2,965m over 10 years vs ~EUR2,750m implied by an APRR-level cash build (EBITDA +3%/yr, capex ~EUR350m, 25.8% tax, full deleveraging) — base is mildly generous to allow for end-of-concession indemnity for unamortised capex.

GREENWAY: TRIP II in lock-up, B+/Negative, EBITDA US$65m vs debt service ~US$67m and zero-coupon accretion ~US$63m/yr — equity is an option on the Dec-2025 rate case (hearing ~Sep/Oct-2026). Base A$150m, bull A$450m, bear 0. Not in the flows; in the bridge.

MARKET CONTEXT: IFM's A$5.10 'best and final' off-market bid closed 7/8-Jul-2026 with 67.43%; no live scheme, so three operating scenarios are used rather than deal-completes/breaks weighting. The gap between this model and A$5.10 is the price a long-duration infrastructure buyer pays for (a) a ~6-7% equity discount rate and (b) APRR continuity beyond 2035 — see required_return_table and the bull renewal lump.

DISTRIBUTION COVERAGE: 40cps guidance = A$580m vs modelled FY2026 distributable cash ~A$450m (31cps) at spot FX — company itself flags 2025/26 payout above the 90-110% policy range. The 40c is partly funded from corporate cash and is not a proxy for sustainable cash generation.
band_position is null: SBC is A$3.4m/yr (0.6% of receipts) so house and street coincide within 1c; the SBC band has collapsed.

historical_growth.growth_rate_source: contractual toll escalation + ~1% traffic on the APRR stream (proportional toll revenue +2.9% FY25, +0.6% ex-FX H1-26); not any statutory CAGR
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Statutory revenue (Greenway/Skyway/Warnow tolls only) and EPS describe <15% of the economics; equity CAGR is distorted by the FY2022 A$3.1bn raise for the extra APRR/Skyway stakes; FCF CAGR is on DistributionsFromAssociates (investing-activity line), which FY2022->23 jumped on the APRR stake increase 25.1%->31.1% and FY2025 fell on TST. None is a forward growth proxy; the model uses explicit per-asset receipt paths.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF series = distributions received from associates (kpis.DistributionsFromAssociates) — statutory operating_cash_flow (88.2 FY25) omits them because they sit in investing activities. FY2017 revenue 473.0 is 83% one-off other income; FY2021 NI includes a 35.8 one-off tax benefit; both excluded from any base.

base.terminal_method: cap binds by construction: terminal_cap_multiple = PV(end-2035) of post-APRR tails / FY2035 distributable cash; Gordon at wacc/terminal_growth would be 20.7x and is NOT used because ~85% of FY2035 cash (APRR) ceases at Nov-2035 expiry

bull.terminal_method: cap binds by construction: terminal_cap_multiple = PV(end-2035) of post-APRR tails / FY2035 distributable cash; Gordon at wacc/terminal_growth would be 23.1x and is NOT used because ~85% of FY2035 cash (APRR) ceases at Nov-2035 expiry

bear.terminal_method: cap binds by construction: terminal_cap_multiple = PV(end-2035) of post-APRR tails / FY2035 distributable cash; Gordon at wacc/terminal_growth would be 18.7x and is NOT used because ~85% of FY2035 cash (APRR) ceases at Nov-2035 expiry

scenario_narratives.base: APRR runs to Nov-2035 expiry with TST rolling off after 2026, tolls +~2%/yr and traffic +~1%; distributions taper from 2032 as APRR/FE deleverages to zero by expiry; no re-concession value. Skyway compounds ~7%/yr on its contractual toll formula and is retained (or sold near this value). Greenway rate case yields a partial increase worth A$150m of equity. FX held at spot.
scenario_narratives.bull: Stronger French traffic and no further French tax measures; APRR distributions ~EUR360m mid-decade and a slower taper; A$600m of value at 2035 from an APRR extension/new French concession (Ambition France Transports keeps the concession model; A412 and A79 tails larger). Greenway rate case fully granted (A$450m); Skyway grows 8%/yr and its tail 4%; weaker AUD (EUR/AUD 1.70). IFM clean-up is NOT priced — it would be a premium on top.
scenario_narratives.bear: TST-style surcharges recur and the long-distance transport tax bites (payout ~EUR285m and falling), traffic flat, APRR deleverages earlier and harder (FY2035 EUR150m); Greenway rate case fails again (equity nil, possible restructuring); Warnow nil; Skyway growth 5%; AUD stronger still (EUR/AUD 1.53, AUD/USD 0.75). 67%-controlled register with thin free float.

entry_price.method: price at which FY2026-35 distributable cash plus the end-2035 residual (Skyway/French tails REBUILT at the 15% hurdle, renewal lump unchanged) plus the bridge returns 15%; per scenario, probability-weighted

required_return_table.note: each row rebuilds the post-2035 residual at that rate; 15% row = base entry price, 8.5% row = base intrinsic value. The current price of A$4.44 sits between the 6.5% and 7.5% rows of the sensitivity grid — the market (and IFM at A$5.10) discounts this stream at an infrastructure-fund cost of equity and/or credits APRR with life beyond 2035.

sensitivity.terminal_growth_meaning: growth of the post-2035 Skyway tail (the only perpetual-like stream); APRR has no terminal growth

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear 20% (above the 15% default): the dominant stream has a hard 2035 stop, French fiscal measures have already cut cash twice (TST 2025, extended 2026), Greenway has lost two rate cases, and the register is 67% controlled. Bull 25% (below 35%): it needs a French re-concession, a Greenway win and a weaker AUD together. Base 55%.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Toll-road holdco valued as the PV of cash actually received at the corporate level over finite concession lives, at cost of equity, with non-recourse project debt left inside the assets and locked-up assets carried at scenario equity values.
valuation_philosophy.why_not_owner_fcf: Consolidated OCF (88.2) captures Greenway/Skyway/Warnow only; the 516.8 of APRR/Skyway distributions sit in investing activities; and APRR expires in 2035 so a Gordon terminal on FY2035 cash would capitalise a stream that stops.
valuation_philosophy.checks_replaced: EV/EBITDA and P/FCF trip rules are not meaningful: ALX has no statutory EBITDA (share of associate profit 270.8 is the earnings line) and reported FCF is 87.6 vs 505.9 company OFCF. Substitute checks: price/OFCF-per-security 4.44/0.349 = 12.7x; distribution yield 9.0%; P/NAV vs company NTA A$4.00/security = 1.11x; IFM bid A$5.10 = 14.6x OFCF.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
